_comment: Copy this OUTSIDE the repo, fill in your values, and point CONTENT_CONFIG_DIR at that directory. Do not place the filled-in file inside this checkout: a path outside the tree is a property, .gitignore is only a promise that `git add -f` breaks. /longtail reads it from there.
_site: Your domain, without protocol. Used in prompts and for internal-link building.
_section: The URL section new articles are published under, with leading and trailing slash. Whatever your site calls it — /blog/, /resources/, /guides/.
_language: Content language. The skill writes in this language; the shipped prompt text is German because the original stack was DACH — translate it to match.
seeds: <compliance or regulation term in your market>
_seeds: Seed terms for the Google Autocomplete sweep. Each seed is expanded a–z, so 8–20 seeds is plenty. Include competitor brands ONLY if you want their comparison queries in your backlog — and be aware that whoever reads this file learns which competitors you track. Keep the real list in longtail.config.json, never here.
_topics: Allowed topic scope. A keyword outside this list is never an article candidate, however good its volume looks. This list is your content strategy — keep the real one in longtail.config.json.
_brandTermsToIgnore: Navigational brand queries. Only the official site ranks for these — never write an article against them.
_trailingSlash: Set to match your site's build config. If true, every internal link needs a trailing slash or it 404s in dev and redirects in prod.
